evidence_limits.interpretation: Two scales diagnose numerical stability, not LR selection. F retains amax/abs/guards/clamps and float32 parameter rounding; unstableFD is not an AD bug. H-S andS-F are nested functional comparisons with interactions. Initial direction evidence does not prove a later training cause or detector-response fit.

frozen_plan_interpretation.scope: Copied pre-registered hypothetical if-then interpretation rules, not observed findings. Overshoot requires small positive steps to descend while full1 harms; sampled-direction mismatch requires first-bank F descent and resolved reused-bank F total harm.

copied_preregistered_rules.step_size: Small positive points descend but full1 harms under the same mode: local finite-step overshoot evidence.
copied_preregistered_rules.crop_ADC: F versus S and S versus H are nested functional controls. They can interact and are not a training-history causal partition.

copied_preregistered_rules.numeric: F retains amax, abs, guards and clamp. Quantized baseline ties and float32 displacement can prevent stableFD; instability alone is not proof of an AD implementation bug.
